notes.title: Notification of Upcoming Game Update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing SD Gundam Battle Alliance.
We would like to provide details for an upcoming game update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42053458/71d3b660674432727aa264e63c11ce9b063fc96f.jpg[/img]

[h2]▼Release Timing for Game Update 1.40[/h2]
[h3]Wednesday, May 10th, 2023 at 11:00 JST[/h3]

[h3]▼Update Details[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added support for paid downloadable content.
[*] Added support for the “SD GUNDAM BATTLE ALLIANCE - Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury Pack”.
[*] The following unit, character, expansion parts, CAPITAL tickets, level uncap materials and GM (Gatheroad) Gundam game collaboration BGM will be available for users that purchase this DLC.
[*] Additional Playable Unit: Gundam Aerial
[*] Additional Character: Suletta Mercury
[*] Three types of additional expansion parts:
[*] The emblem of the Holder (Infighters, All-Rounders and Sharpshooters)
     - Effect: Aerial Damage +8％ / Sidestep Invulnerability Time +0.02S / [Main Ranged and Subweapons] Reload+5％
[*] Miorine's Tomato
     - Effect [Infighter]: Melee +150 / [beam type] Melee Attack +20％ / [All Attacks] Stagger Effect +20％
     - Effect [All-Rounder]: Melee +100 / Ranged +100 / [All Attacks] Stagger Effect +20％
     - Effect [Sharpshooter]: Ranged +150 / [beam type] Ranged Attack +20％ / [All Attacks] Stagger Effect +20％
[*] “GUND-ARM Inc. Clip” Expansion Part (Infighters, All-Rounders and Sharpshooters)
    - Effect: Dropped Capital +2500 / Full MS Repair Kit +15％ / Hate +100％
[*] Additional CAPITAL Tickets: 100,000 CAPITAL tickets x3
[*] Additional Level Uncap Materials:
     - 1st Level Uncap Materials: (Infighters, All-Rounders, and Sharpshooters) ×3
     - 2nd Level Uncap Materials: (Infighters, All-Rounders, and Sharpshooters) ×4
[*] GM (Gatheroad) Gundam Game Collaboration BGM:
     - CALM - MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM BATTLE OPERATION 2
     - EMERGENCY - MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM BATTLE OPERATION 2
     - Battle IV - MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM U.C. ENGAGE
     - A New Encounter I - MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM U.C. ENGAGE
[*] The “SD GUNDAM BATTLE ALLIANCE - Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury Pack” paid DLC will be available on May 11th, 2023.
[*] Please note that there will no additional missions.
[/list]
[h3]● Other Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue which caused the third attack from Gundam Astray Red Frame Kai’s SPA to miss when performed in the air.
[*] Fixed an issue which caused the final attack from Gundam Kimaris Vidar’s SPA to miss when performed in the air.
[*] Fixed an issue which caused Gundam Barbatos Lupus Rex’s counter to miss when used against certain attacks.
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented SPA recast speedup bonuses to be received when using subweapons with the following units:
     Destiny Gundam / Gelgoog (Char) / Gouf Custom / Justice Gundam / Infinite Justice Gundam / The-O / Turn A Gundam
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented expansion part effects to not trigger when the following units use a ranged weapon and then perform other attacks before the ranged weapon attack hits the enemy:
      Gelgoog (Char) / Qubeley / Nu Gundam　/ Sazabi / Hi-Nu Gundam / Kshatriya / Penelope / Providence Gundam / Strike Freedom Gundam / Cherudim Gundam / Arche Gundam / Reborns Gundam / 00 QAN[T] / Phoenix Gundam 
[*] Fixed an issue in multiplayer which caused equipped expansion parts with “Perfect Guard Skill Meter Recovery” effects to not trigger for the guest even after a perfect guard is performed against a ranged attack.
[*] Fixed an issue which caused an event that doesn’t usually occur in multiplayer to trigger when the host player selects “Gundam” as a partner and plays the “Hero of Lacroa“ mission in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed an issue which caused some dialogue to not be displayed in the “Seen and Unseen“ mission after  “Apsaras III” appears.
[/list]

We apologize for the length of time required to release this game update. Thank you for your continued support of "SD Gundam Battle Alliance".

notes.title: Notice of the update data of the game
notes.content:
[h3][b]Thank you for playing SD Gundam Battle Alliance. We would like to provide details for the update.[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42053458/41b5a98d2c0cfe4dcb1daa3d63e7e1664f9071a1.png[/img]

[h2][b]▼Release Timing for the game update ver. 1.31 
November 30, 2022 (Wednesday)[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]▼Game Update Details[/b][/h3]
•	The amount of damage to the balancer gauge of Justice Gundam Subweapon 1 Bassel Beam Boomerang for was less than expected, so the amount of damage has been increased.

•	When Gundam Gusion Rebake Full City’s Subweapon 2 110mm Rifle (simultaneous fire) hits an enemy in the air, it now always cause a knockdown if the balancer gauge is zero

•	Fixed an issue where Legendary Gundam’s Special Attack would sometimes would not hit an enemy

•	Fixed an issue where Knight Superior Dragon’s attack Golden Dragon Bow would not damage the balancer meter when hitting an airborne enemy

•	Fixed an issue where Moon Gundam’s Subweapon1 Psycho Plate (Shield) balancer meter damage was different depending on whether the enemy was on the ground or airbourne, they should now be equal

•	Fixed an issue in which Xi Gundam’s counter-attacks against Zeong’s melee attacks were not connecting

•	Fixed an issue in which Penelope’s Subweapon 2 Funnel Missel would disappear and cause its special attack to be unresponsive

•	The following units have had their air damage adjusted
[list]
[*] Increased the amount of damage when the aerial special attack of Hi-Nu Gundam hits in mid-air.
[*] Increased the amount of damage when the Crossbone Gundam X2’s Subweapon2 Shot Lancer (Rush) hits in the air.
[*] Increased the amount of damage when the Arios Gundam's ground Subweapon 1 GN Submachine Gun hits in the air.
[*] Increased the amount of damage when the aerial special attack of Gundam Kimaris Vidar hits in the air.
[*] Increased the amount of damage when the aerial special attack of Gundam Latreia hits in the air.
[*] Increased the amount of damage when the Phoenix Gundam's Subweapon 2 "Mega Beam Cannon" hits in mid-air.
[/list]

・In the DLC mission "Destination of the Legend," when a specific enemy ace unit that appears at a high altitude was immediately destroyed, drops were placed in areas inaccessible to the player, this has been corrected

[h3][b]We apologize for any inconvenience and thank you for your continued support of "SD Gundam Battle Alliance”.[/b][/h3]

notes.title: [Important Notice] Regarding future updates for “SD GUNDAM BATTLE ALLIANCE”
notes.content:
[h3][b]Thank you for playing “SD Gundam Battle Alliance”.
We have read the various comments and requests from our community and will consider addressing them in future updates.[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42053458/6338b4304e4b0afe9367240cbe742c4caacf0ba6.jpg[/img]

[h3][b][Confirmed Phenomena and Request][/b][/h3]
[b]Balance adjustment of boss battles such as Mobile Armor battles[/b]
- We have received feedback that Mobile Armor's HP is high, making it difficult to clear the first time on Normal or to play around the bosses. To make it easier to take down, we plan to adjust the balancer gauge of Mobile Armor.
We are also considering adjusting the HP of some Mobile Armor.

[b]Regarding the number of capitals [/b]
- We have received feedback that the amount of capitals acquired in the early to mid-game is low, making it difficult to strengthen multiple Mobile Suits.
In a future update, we plan to adjust the amount of capitals acquired throughout the game.

[b]Lock-on behavior when destroying enemy [/b]
- We are considering addressing the issues of slow switching of lock-on targets when destroying enemy and slow timing of item drops.
Regarding the lock-on switching issue, we are planning to implement a function that will allow users to optionally switch between before and after adjustment of lock-on switching.

[b]Regarding item drops, we are planning to adjust the timing of item and capital drops to be equally faster.[/b]

[b]Improvements to keyboard/mouse control[/b]
- We are planning to support side keys on the mouse control and to enable one-button setting for simultaneous actions on the keyboard.

[b]In addition to the above, we plan to make improvements and address issues in future updates.[/b]

[h3][b][Future Updates][/b][/h3]
[b]We are currently working on updates to address current known issues. We will announce the release schedule for the updates once it has been determined.

We apologize for any inconvenience these issues may have caused and ask that you kindly wait for the updates to be released.[/b]

[h3][b]Thank you for your continued support of "SD Gundam Battle Alliance".[/b][/h3]

notes.title: "SD Gundam Battle Alliance” Notification of the upcoming update data
notes.content:
Thank you for playing SD Gundam Battle Alliance. 
We would like to provide details for an upcoming game update.

[b][h3]Release Timing for the update patch 1.10
[/h3][/b]Wednesday, September 7th, 2022

[b][h3]Outline of the update
[/h3][/b]The status of Mobile Suits, such as beam fighting resistance, have been improved.
Gundam Barbatos (6th Form)
Gundam Barbatos Lupus
Gundam Barbatos Lupus Rex
Gundam Gusion Rebake Full City
Gundam Bael
Reginlaze Julia
GM (Gatheroad)

Unlock the Mobile Suit upper level
MS level 90
Pilot Level 90
Partner Pilot level 90
*The uncapping materials is required to raise the MS level to 81 or higher.

Phoenix Gundam will become available
It will only appear as a playable Mobile Suit. Please note that it cannot be registered as a partner Mobile Suit.

Unit Uncapping Materials Combo Pack 1 will be added
10,000 CAPITAL ticket x 5
1st Level Uncap Materials: Infighter x 10
1st Level Uncap Materials: All-Rounder x10
1st Level Uncap Materials: Sharpshooter x10

Free missions "EX Missions" have been added.
EX Mission 01, EX Mission 02, and EX Mission 03
*These are challenging contents that can be played after clearing all Hard Mode missions except for Chaos Missions.

The paid DLC mission “Legend & Succession " is now supported.
The following missions will be playable if you have purchased the DLC1.
“The Cursed Treasure ", " Destination of the Legend ", "EX Mission Extreme 1", and "EX Mission Extreme 2".

*Please note that in order to play "EX Mission Extreme 1" and "EX Mission Extreme 2," you will need to complete the "Cursed Treasures" and "Where Myths Lead" missions in addition to the free EX Missions.

Other improvements have been made to improve stability of operations.

We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the delay in distributing the update data.

Future Actions

notes.title: [Important Notice] Known Issues in "SD Gundam Battle Alliance"
notes.content:
[i][b]Thank you for playing “SD Gundam Battle Alliance”.
We have read the various comments and requests from our customers and will consider addressing them in future updates.[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42053458/9089c016f02bf447333f6aceb7367e71e92d41c4.png[/img]

[b][h3][Known Issues and Requests][/h3][/b]
[b]●The message, ”This game is shutting down as it was opened in an unsupported OS.” is displayed and the application cannot be started.[/b]
[i]- We are currently investigating this issue.[/i]

[b]●Gameplay feels heavy/slow even though the required PC specs have been met.[/b]
[i]- We are currently investigating whether this can be improved in a future update.[/i]

[b]●After configuring the “Edit Music” setting, the music set does not play.
 In addition, songs are overlapped during playback or the music just stops.[/b]
[i]- We are currently working on a fix. Improvements will be made in a future update.
  Please try restarting the application or reconfiguring the music to resolve the issue.[/i]

[b]●Improvements to keyboard and mouse controls[/b]
[i]- We are currently investigating whether the controls can be improved in a future update.[/i]

[b]●Support for mouse side buttons[/b]
[i]- We are currently investigating whether this can be improved in a future update.[/i]

●When “Display Mode” is set to "Borderless Windowed", the screen is displayed in desktop resolution instead of the actual screen resolution that is set.[/b]
[i]- Improvements will be made in a future update.[/i]

[b]●When using a 4:3 aspect ratio monitor (resolution: 1280x960), the screen display is stretched.[/b]
[i]- Improvements will be made in a future update.[/i]

[b]●“Anti-Aliasing", "Texture Filter", and "Shadows" settings are not reflected in the game.[/b]
[i]- Improvements will be made in a future update.[/i]

[b]●When the room host is confirming enemy MS/MA appearance on the multiplayer mission selection screen, if another player who has not unlocked the mission enters the room, the host will temporarily lose control of the game.[/b]
[i]- Improvements will be made in a future update.[/i]

[b]●In Multiplayer, when the room host is confirming enemy MS/MA appearance on the "Select Mode/Difficulty" screen, if another player who has not unlocked the mission enters the room, the host will lose control of the game.[/b]
[i]- Improvements will be made in a future update.[/i]

[b]●When trying to enter a room after receiving an invite, an error message is not displayed and the screen turns black if the room has already been closed.[/b]
[i]- Improvements will be made in a future update.[/i]

[b]In addition to the above, we plan to make improvements and address issues in future updates.[/b]

[h3][b][Future Updates][/b][/h3]
[u][b]We are currently working on updates[/b][/u] to address the current known issues. We will announce the release schedule for the updates once it has been determined.

[b][h3]We apologize for any inconvenience these issues may have caused and ask that you  kindly wait for the updates to be released.
Thank you for your continued support of "SD Gundam Battle Alliance".[/h3][/b]

●When using a 4:3 aspect ratio monitor (resolution: 1280x960), the screen display is stretched.
●“Anti-Aliasing", "Texture Filter", and "Shadows" settings are not reflected in the game.

notes.title: SD GUNDAM BATTLE ALLIANCE is now available! 🤖
notes.content:
[h2]Explore the unpredictable G: Universe and [b]join the Battle Alliance.[/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=Y7SnjwlP3JY;full][/previewyoutube]
From Mobile Suit Gundam to Iron-Blooded Orphans, SD GUNDAM BATTLE ALLIANCE brings together different narratives that let [b]players relive famous scenes and battles from the venerable anime series.[/b]

[b]Join forces[/b] to correct a distorted world, overcoming rifts in time known as “Historical Breaks” to [b]restore the true timeline of every Gundam series![/b] Each mission features single-player and multiplayer action, allowing up to three players to work together to progress through the game.

SD GUNDAM BATTLE ALLIANCE also[b] features a progression system[/b] where players must develop, enhance, and reinforce their [b]Mobile Suits[/b] with blueprints acquired during the course of their missions.

The game boasts [b]fast-paced combat[/b] and players will have a [b]variety of melee and ranged attacks[/b], [b]combos[/b], and [b]charge-based special attacks[/b] for [b]each Mobile Suit in their arsenals[/b].

[h3]SD GUNDAM BATTLE ALLIANCE is now available![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/824550/SD_GUNDAM_BATTLE_ALLIANCE/
